audit.why: Level 6 (Depth Charge is unstoppable and chains Q+passive+W into a full lockdown), first item (his Q-E-R chain becomes a near-guaranteed kill and W shield tanks poke through the all-in), and 2+ items (Sona's aura DPS and Power Chord slow out-kite his single hard-commit) are the real power spikes and content already states them; full layer's cooldowns/dosFull needed the real numbers.

edits.before: Q-chord the contacts — the aura poke is quiet and constant; the lane pays per note.
edits.after: Even: Nautilus is entirely hook-reliant, so a dodged Dredge Line (14s cooldown at rank 1) lets you punish freely with Q poke while he waits it out.

edits.before: W answers the trades: the sustain mirror opens and yours compounds.
edits.after: Even: neither of you can force a kill unless Dredge Line lands, but one landed hook into his passive root and W can chunk your carry hard — discipline decides this level, not aura chip.

edits.before: Full kit: the chord colors decide trades — power chord the carry, speed the disengage.
edits.after: Even: his cooldown-gated hook keeps trades neutral as long as you never facecheck brush or stand behind a low minion he can hook through.

edits.before: Aura economy: chip, heal, speed — the margins are invisible and decisive.
edits.after: Still even: he's hook-dependent before his ult comes online, so the same discipline that worked at level 1 still holds.

edits.before: Crescendo online — grouped lanes pay the dance tax; your duo's all-in has a stage.
edits.after: Depth Charge (R) is an unstoppable homing knockup that chains with Dredge Line and Titan's Wrath into a full lockdown — hold Crescendo to peel your carry the instant he R's, and Aria-shield before the chain lands.

edits.before: First item: the auras compound and the chords chunk.
edits.after: His hardest spike: the Q-E-R chain becomes a near-guaranteed kill if it connects and his W shield tanks your poke through the all-in — keep max range and only shield reactively.

edits.before: Late Sona scales into a one-button teamfight: crescendo the clump and aura the cleanup.
edits.after: Two items in you flip it: if Dredge Line misses he has no engage, and your aura DPS, Power Chord slow and Crescendo let you kite and out-teamfight his single hard-commit.

edits.before: - Nautilus Dredge Line (Hook): matchup-defining — His only real engage — dodge it and the lane is free. It writes your spacing rules. - E Song of Celerity is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: Dredge Line starts at 14s cooldown, down to 10s maxed — dodge it and he has no engage until it's back. Depth Charge is 120s at rank 1, 80s maxed and unstoppable once cast — Song of Celerity can't outrun it, so peel with Crescendo instead.

edits.before: Nautilus spends Dredge Line (Hook) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Punish every whiffed hook with Q poke — Dredge Line is 14s at rank 1, and he has nothing else to threaten you with while it's down.
